imagens.alt: FX options data packages In-depth coverage of FX volatility surfaces across at-the-money straddles, risk reversals, and butterflies. By providing live, executable prices published on the Volbroker platform, you can trust the integrity of our data. We publish real-time volatility price transparency in ATM straddles, risk reversals and butterflies. In 2001 Tradition integrated the Volbroker system into its currency options business. Volbroker was the first electronic inter-dealer trading environment for FX options. Designed by FX options traders for real-time performance, with liquidity support from the world’s top interbank market makers, Volbroker is a leading platform for electronic price transparency and efficiency in the currency derivatives market. The FX market transparency you need to maximize alpha and manage risk. “ ” deliverable forward pairs >200 forward & NDF currency pairs >260 spot/crosses >3500 currencies 60 John Crisp Head of FX Product and Strategy TFS Volbroker FX options 50+ currency pairs for ATM Straddles, including 25 & 10 Delta risk reversals and butterflies. FX option prices, and related market data, is sourced from liquidity originating from both the voice broker desks and from the leading FX options electronic broking platform, Volbroker. Enhanced FX options Our Enhanced FX options pricing provides expanded coverage using Tradition’s global FX options pricing and trade data. – Volatility surfaces in 140 currency pairs with tenors from 1W up to 30Y, depending on currency pair and liquidity – Products include ATM straddles, and 5, 10, 15, 25 & 35 Delta risk reversals and butterflies – 3 EOD snaps per day (London, New York and Tokyo closes) Built around Tradition’s presence as a leading global OTC broker with extensive inter-bank pricing, complemented by TraditionData’s best-in-class analytics, our FX market data product suite provides a comprehensive view across the spectrum of the world’s FX markets. Coverage includes spot and related crosses, deliverable FX forwards, non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in both outrights and points, IMM dates, quarterly turns and some central bank meeting fixed settlement date instruments. We also offer our customers deep local markets expertise in locations including, but not limited to, China, Singapore, Taiwan, Indonesia, Philippines, Australia/New Zealand, Chile, Colombia, Israel and South Africa. To view our full range of FX products please visit www.traditiondata.com TraditionData FX packages Comprehensive coverage across spot, forward, NDF and FX options gives you an in-depth view of the global FX marketplace. https://qrco.de/bdJmi1
